en-US.author: Sergey Moskalev
en-US.description: A smart automatic keyboard layout switcher with weekly updated language model.
en-US.longDescription:
Caramba Switcher Pro is the Pro edition of the smart automatic keyboard layout switcher from the creator of Punto Switcher. It switches the layout automatically as you type and is an indispensable tool for those who constantly have to work with text.
The Pro edition adds weekly updates to the built-in language model and correct typing of the Russian letter ё according to the rules of the language.
en-US.name: Caramba Switcher Pro

zh-CN.description: 智能自动键盘布局切换器，内置每周更新的语言模型。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Caramba Switcher Pro 是出自 Punto Switcher 作者之手的智能自动键盘布局切换器的专业版。它能在输入时自动切换布局，是经常需要处理文本的用户不可或缺的工具。
专业版提供每周更新的内置语言模型，并支持按俄语语言规范自动输入字母 ё。
